Sets the topic to query and subscribe to. The topic specified can be the
literal topic name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

A comma-delimited set of options for this command. For an aggregated
subscription, the options provide the projection and grouping for the
command. An aggregated SOW and Subscribe can include options in
addition to projection and grouping. The most common additional
options are:
oof - Request out of focus notifications.
timestamp - Include timestamp headers on messages.
